capabilities: Render inline buttons from sm: tokens that trigger server scenes, events, sounds, music and light resets
Autocomplete scene, event and sound ids while typing tokens
Show entity tile art and emoji on buttons with chip or banner styles
Highlight buttons whose scene, event or sound is currently active
Embed the full Ambient Director control panel in an Obsidian tab
disambiguation: A companion to the Ambient Director server app; it triggers scenes remotely, it does not play audio or control lights inside Obsidian itself.
extras: Not in the Obsidian community store and not reviewed by Obsidian staff; must be built from source and installed manually. Server must be reachable on the same LAN; embedded panel over a remote LAN IP may be blocked by mixed-content policy.
problem: Running table ambiance from Ambient Director means switching away from Obsidian, since session notes and scene control live in separate windows.

relations.evidence: Fire Ambient Director scenes, events and sounds straight from your session notes
use the Hot-Reload plugin to reload it in Obsidian automatically

summary: Remote control for the Ambient Director tabletop server: inline note buttons fire scenes, events, sounds and music, plus an embedded control panel.
